name: A quoted ability is fired from the permanent that gets it — Foul Presence, Blazing Torch, Dementia Sliver, Shameless Charlatan
notes: Memory: project_audit_quoted_target_2026-11-11. The audit's quoted units (tests/audit.js auditQuoted) grant a quoted ability that names a target and fire it from the bearer. Foul Presence's granted '{T}: Target creature gets -1/-1' fired from Grizzly Bears: its source is the Bears (CR 113.7), so protection from green keeps Vodalian Zombie out and protection from black (Foul Presence's colour) does not keep Great Sable Stag out; an opponent's hexproof Gladecover Scout is out. Fixed: the card's own name inside a quote granted to another permanent became 'this card' on that permanent ('{T}, Sacrifice this card: this card deals 2 damage' on the creature wearing Blazing Torch; _replaceProperNounSelfRef keeps the name unless the grant names the card itself). Dementia Sliver's 'All Slivers have "… Target opponent reveals …"' reached no Sliver: the quoted 'target opponent' tagged the grant as one for the chosen opponent's permanents (_finalizeEffects now masks quotes). Shameless Charlatan's 'Commander creatures you own have "{2}{U}: This creature becomes a copy of another target creature."' made no effect: the copy reader matched inside the quote and claimed the line.

$includes: {T}, Sacrifice Blazing Torch: Blazing Torch deals 2 damage to any target.
{T}: Choose a card name. Target opponent reveals a card at random from their hand. If that card has the chosen name, that player discards it. Activate only during your turn.
{2}{U}: This creature becomes a copy of another target creature.
